tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search Less Annoying CRM contacts and companies. query matches record fields. record_type is contacts or companies; omit it to search both. Returns at most 25 records (default 10).

tools.name: get_contact_history
tools.description: Read one Less Annoying CRM contact plus the notes, pipeline items, and tasks that make up its history. contact_id is the numeric contact id. Notes and tasks default to 10 (maximum 25).
